groups.name: dataflow.workspace
groups.description: Settings of the Workspace as a whole

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.access
groups.description: Grants: who may read, run and change what, shared by every Workspace replica

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.alerts
groups.description: Firing alerts the Workspace reads from Grafana for the Alerts page

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.auth
groups.description: How people sign in: the OIDC login provider, the token claims read and the administrator groups

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.catalog
groups.description: Catalog views ClickHouse keeps over every lake table

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.compute-policy
groups.description: The most a run may ask for; edits above it are refused and the tower lowers older releases to it

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.git
groups.description: Git folders: the clones pipeline specs are edited and committed in

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github
groups.description: Connecting Git folders to GitHub through a GitHub App

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.housekeeping
groups.description: How long previews, Spark event logs and releases stay, and when housekeeping removes them unasked

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.http
groups.description: Timeouts of outbound HTTP calls: connections, setup checks and source probes

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.links
groups.description: Addresses of the platform's other tools, shown in Settings and on run pages

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.person
groups.description: The person the Workspace acts as when sign-in is off

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.releases
groups.description: The store released projects are written to and the target shown as deployed

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.serving
groups.description: The ClickHouse server every lake read and SQL query goes through

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.sources
groups.description: What drafts and releases may read besides public web addresses

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access
groups.description: Dataset read grants published as RustFS policies on the lake bucket

groups.name: dataflow.workspace.tower
groups.description: The Dagster tower that schedules and launches every run

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.access.refresh-every
properties.description: How often each replica reloads grants changed by another replica

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.alerts.grafana
properties.description: Grafana address the Workspace reads firing alerts from; empty turns the Alerts page off

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.alerts.timeout
properties.description: How long the Workspace waits for Grafana to list firing alerts

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.alerts.token-file
properties.description: File holding a Grafana service-account token (Viewer), written by the monitoring stack

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.admins
properties.description: Groups whose members are administrators: every right, Settings, the audit log

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.client-id
properties.description: OIDC client of the Workspace at the login provider; tokens must name it as audience or authorized party

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.client-secret
properties.description: Secret of a confidential OIDC client; empty for a public client with PKCE

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.groups-claim
properties.description: Token claim that lists the person's groups

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.internal
properties.description: Address of the login provider as the Workspace reaches it (token, keys, user info)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.issuer
properties.description: Issuer the browser sees and tokens carry; must match the provider's issuer exactly

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.mode
properties.description: none: no sign-in, everyone is an administrator; oidc: sign in with the login provider

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.auth.username-claim
properties.description: Token claim used as the person's id

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.catalog.small-file
properties.description: A live Delta file under this size counts as small on a pipeline board's Storage panel

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.catalog.sync-every
properties.description: How often catalog views in ClickHouse are checked against new commits

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.compute-policy.max-driver-cores
properties.description: Most driver cores a run may ask for; empty for no limit

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.compute-policy.max-driver-memory
properties.description: Largest driver (or, with Docker, container) memory a run may ask for, such as 4g; empty for no limit

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.compute-policy.max-executor-cores
properties.description: Most cores per executor on Kubernetes; empty for no limit

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.compute-policy.max-executor-memory
properties.description: Largest memory per executor on Kubernetes, such as 8g; empty for no limit

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.compute-policy.max-executors
properties.description: Most executors a run may scale to on Kubernetes; empty for no limit

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.dashboards
properties.description: Grafana dashboards listed under Dashboards → Grafana (uid, title, group, description)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.cache-dir
properties.description: Disk cache of Git folder clones; safe to lose, refetched on demand

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.file-remotes
properties.description: Local directories allowed as file:// Git remotes (development only)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.api
properties.description: GitHub API address (GitHub Enterprise has its own)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.app-slug
properties.description: Slug of an existing GitHub App; empty lets the Workspace create its own on first use

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.client-id
properties.description: Client id of an existing GitHub App

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.client-secret
properties.description: Client secret of an existing GitHub App

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.host
properties.description: GitHub web address

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.public-url
properties.description: Address GitHub sends people back to; defaults to the Workspace's own

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.git.github.timeout
properties.description: How long the Workspace waits for an answer from GitHub

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.housekeeping.event-log-days
properties.description: Days Spark event logs stay under spark-events/ before housekeeping offers to remove them

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.housekeeping.keep-releases
properties.description: Newest releases kept per project; older ones no target points to can be removed

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.housekeeping.upload-days
properties.description: Days an uploaded file stays under uploads/ before housekeeping offers to remove it, unless a spec reads it

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.housekeeping.schedule
properties.description: When to remove what housekeeping offers unasked, a cron such as 0 0 3 * * *; - leaves it to an administrator

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.housekeeping.preview-days
properties.description: Days preview and inference results stay under system/tasks/ before housekeeping offers to remove them

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.http.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long the Workspace waits to connect to a service over HTTP

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.http.probe-timeout
properties.description: How long a setup check or a source probe waits for an answer; raise it for slow networks

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.links.dashboards
properties.description: Grafana address shown in Settings

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.links.mail
properties.description: Mail catcher address shown in Settings (development)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.links.spark-history
properties.description: Spark History Server address for administrators; runs link to their Spark UI there; empty hides it

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.links.object-store
properties.description: Object store console address shown in Settings

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.links.serving
properties.description: ClickHouse address shown in Settings

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.links.tower
properties.description: Dagster UI address shown in Settings and on run pages

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.person.email
properties.description: E-mail of commits made without sign-in

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.person.id
properties.description: Person id used without sign-in

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.person.name
properties.description: Name of commits made without sign-in

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.access-key
properties.description: Access key of the release store; empty uses the default credential chain

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.bucket
properties.description: Bucket the Workspace writes releases to and the tower reads them from

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.cache-dir
properties.description: Disk cache of materialized releases

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.endpoint
properties.description: S3 endpoint of the release store; empty for AWS

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.path-style
properties.description: Address buckets as endpoint/bucket (RustFS, MinIO) instead of bucket.endpoint

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.refresh-every
properties.description: How often the Workspace looks for new release pointers

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.region
properties.description: Region of the release store

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.secret-key
properties.description: Secret key of the release store

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.releases.target
properties.description: Release target the Workspace shows as deployed (prod)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.collection
properties.description: ClickHouse named collection that reaches the lake; queries never carry keys

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.dashboard-rows
properties.description: The most rows one chart of a dashboard reads from ClickHouse

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.database
properties.description: ClickHouse database of published tables

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.lake-root
properties.description: Lake root; its scheme picks the ClickHouse table functions (S3 or Azure)

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.max-rows
properties.description: Most rows the SQL editor and samples return

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.password
properties.description: Password of the ClickHouse service user

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.timeout
properties.description: Longest a ClickHouse request may take

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.url
properties.description: ClickHouse HTTP address

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.serving.user
properties.description: ClickHouse service user

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.sources.allowed-hosts
properties.description: Internal hosts people other than administrators may read sources from, such as a company file server

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.sources.allowed-paths
properties.description: Path prefixes people other than administrators may read sources from; empty means none

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access.browser-url
properties.description: Public RustFS console origin used for links to permitted dataset paths

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access.bucket
properties.description: Lake bucket whose dataset prefixes follow Workspace grants

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access.enabled
properties.description: Publish dataset read grants as conditional RustFS policies; disabled for other object stores

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access.endpoint
properties.description: RustFS S3 and administration origin; policy updates use the configured release-store credentials

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access.legacy-policies
properties.description: Owned readonly/readwrite console policy aliases to restrict during migration; empty preserves other installs

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.storage-access.timeout
properties.description: Longest each RustFS policy update may take

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.tower.location
properties.description: Dagster code location of DataFlow

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.tower.max-output
properties.description: The most of a run's log the Run page reads, per log file; a longer log is cut and marked truncated

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.tower.repository
properties.description: Dagster repository inside that location

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.tower.task-job
properties.description: Dagster job that runs previews, impact and inference

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.tower.timeout
properties.description: Longest a call to the tower's GraphQL API may take

properties.name: dataflow.workspace.tower.url
properties.description: Dagster GraphQL address
